API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APILocation ManagementGet Location Template
Get Location Template
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/locationTemplate/:id

Gets location template specified by location template ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED

Location template ID.

Responses
​
default

Default Response. See API Response Codes

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

ID of Cloud & Branch Connector location template.

name
string

Name of Cloud & Branch Connector location template.

desc
string

Description of Cloud & Branch Connector location template.

template
object
editable
boolean

Whether Cloud & Branch Connector location template is editable.

lastModUid
object
lastModTime
int32

Last time Cloud & Branch Connector location template was modified.
